title: List a used surfboard
ask: I'm selling my old surfboard and want a listing drafted. The details are in item.md and some recent sales of similar boards are in comps.csv. Write the listing for me to look over.
background: It's a 6'2" shortboard I rode for about three summers at Maroubra.
There is a repaired ding on the left rail, done properly by a shaper.
I'd like it gone before I move at the end of the month.

constraints.text: give one asking price in dollars and keep it at $340 or under
keep the title, which is the first line, to 60 characters or fewer
keep the whole listing under 120 words
draft only, don't post the listing anywhere
mention the repaired ding on the left rail

start.item.md:
6'2" shortboard, 29 litres, thruster fins included.
Repaired ding on left rail.
Pickup: Maroubra.
start.comps.csv:
sold_date,title,condition,price

2026-02-18,6'2 shortboard with fins,good,340
